title: Everlasting God
story:
A child once asked his father,

“Where did everything begin?”

The father picked up a rope.

He stretched it across the room.

“Imagine this rope is time,” he said.

“This end is the beginning.”

“And that end is the future.”

The child nodded.

Then he asked,

“Where is God on the rope?”

The father smiled.

“He is not on the rope.”

“He made the rope.”

The child looked confused at first.

Then slowly, he understood.

God was not limited like us.

In life, we think in terms of beginnings and endings.

We measure time.

We worry about the future.

We hold on to the past.

But God is beyond time.

Before anything existed,

He was there.

Long after everything changes,

He remains.

He does not change.

He does not fade.

He is eternal.

And we can trust Him,

because He sees all of time at once.
life_lesson:
God is eternal and unchanging.

Trust Him, because He is beyond time and fully in control.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for being everlasting.

You were before all things and You remain forever.

When I feel uncertain about the future, help me trust You.

Remind me that You are not limited by time.

Give me peace knowing that my life is in Your hands.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you worry about the future or regret the past?

Do you trust that God is beyond time and in control?

How can you rest in His eternal nature today?
verse:
Before the mountains were born.
Or You brought forth the whole world.
From everlasting to everlasting, You are God.
